trophies.guide: This one unlocks itself once the other 54 are done — there is nothing extra to chase. Work through the roadmap below and the platinum lands when the last trophy pops. No multiplayer or DLC is needed.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: The opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It pops on its own as the story moves — nothing optional about it.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. A story trophy, so it cannot be missed — keep playing the main missions and it arrives.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Another story trophy that unlocks automatically as you work through the main missions. Note the asterisks in the official name.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. It pops when the chapter's last main mission ends.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Story only — no side content feeds into it.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission in Chapter 5. After the credits, free roam stays open, so the cleanup in step 2 of the roadmap can start right away.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks in the natural course of the story.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Story trophy, unmissable.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Story trophy, unmissable.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Story trophy, unmissable.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Story trophy, unmissable.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Story trophy, unmissable.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game checklist, which shows up after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. It asks for 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, 15 of 18 meditations, 300 of 397 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 100 optional missions, all 39 illegal operations, all 8 bank vaults, and Bret's 15 target decks. It is the longest single grind in the game, so start the vehicle scans and animal studies during the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land any 250 of the 397 stunts on the map: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights, and 25 base jumps. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this one. Find stunt spots on the map under Exploration, and watch the count under Progress, Activities, Stunts.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample all nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race, and a stunt. One try each is enough — no wins or medals needed.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Take gold in all 42 shooting range challenges across the two ranges: Rodgers Ranch and Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn, and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. Most challenges run three difficulty tiers, and some stay locked until you meet their condition. Track them under Activities, Shooting Ranges.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. A few charge an entry fee, so keep some cash handy. Track them under Activities, Drones, Top Fun Drones.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — winning the same one twice does not count. Most race spots let you hire a car, and a car's Rating matters, so spend on Mod Shop upgrades when the wins stop coming. Track under Activities, Racing.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal texts you a fishing spot after you meet him in Chapter 1. The catch he wants is a parrotfish over 2 kg, and you need a boat with a rod — hijack one if you have to.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Play any in-game video game through to the end. Three of them run on the TV at home and a fourth sits on arcade machines around the state.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's side strand, which starts with a phone call in Chapter 3. Lucia only.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving strand — seven shipwrecks in all. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 and comes back later, so this one cannot be missed. The last mission is Maritime Disputes.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand at the mud club in Kelly County. It opens in Chapter 2, and the last mission is Hometown Heroes.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight qualifying stranger mission strands. Only some side questlines count, and which ones is still being pinned down — but everything can be done after the story, and these strands do not feed into the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's wish list of 16 sports cars. It opens in Chapter 3.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand by shutting down labs around Vice City. Jason only, from Chapter 3.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots. A spot only counts once the final zen animation plays. Track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations, and find them on the map under Exploration, Meditate Around Leonida. POSSIBLY MISSABLE: one morning meditation in Chapter 1 at Jason's house — Lucia meditates on the balcony, follow her and take the optional quest — is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not clear whether the trophy needs it. PowerPyx flags it; Push Square lists no missables. Do it when it comes up.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Jason only, from Chapter 2. Which animal actually triggers it is still unconfirmed — clearing all 15 of Bret's target decks, which the 100% checklist needs anyway, should cover it.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 card sets — the 100% checklist wants 15. Cards sold at pawn shops still count toward progress. Track them under Progress, Collections, Collectible Cards.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK phone app — hold Up to open it. The pool is 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags. Track them under Progress, Collections, WAiNK Locations.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 in-game challenges — the 100% checklist wants 70. Track them under Progress, Challenges.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape. It becomes possible once both characters can roam together in Chapter 2, and bank jobs hand out 4 stars anyway.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner, keeping the wanted level the whole time. It pops about 30 seconds after the third shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A WAiNK scan is enough — you never have to drive them. The 100% checklist wants 200 of 277. Track them under Progress, Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop five enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Gang members count toward the five; soldiers, police, and civilians seem not to.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet parked at a gate at Vice City International Airport and fly it about a kilometre away.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. They have been found at Mile Zero Air Station in the southwest of the map.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being spotted. You need the Snap Gun, which a Chapter 3 main mission hands you.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and get away. There are eight vaults in total and the 100% checklist wants all eight. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4. Grade note: one guide lists this as Bronze; the list used here and two other sources call it Silver.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The first bank job counts, or crack a truck's back door open with a sticky bomb earlier in the game.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map. A plane is the fastest way to sweep the state.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the nine gangs. There are 39 operations in total, and the 100% checklist wants all of them.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed — no reliable steps have been published for this one yet. Do not chase rumours; check back once a guide confirms it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed — no reliable steps have been published for this one yet.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Take all three key valuables from the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn. The robbery comes back later in the game, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia. Work out together and both of them gain progress. Note: one guide does not mark this one as hidden.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that move your Criminal Profile. It builds up on its own across a full playthrough.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed. One guide suspects a link to a Payday Loans store, but that is a suspicion, not a confirmed step — do not treat it as fact yet.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed. One guide suspects a UFO questline, but that is a suspicion, not a confirmed step.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed. The in-game hint points to a melee attack from a moving vehicle, and one guide suspects a kick from a motorcycle — neither is confirmed.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through fences and contacts. It adds up across robberies, and the dye pack jammer you need unlocks in a Chapter 3 main mission.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods, and tattoos get you there fastest.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all eight purchasable garages, for about $160,000 in total. The real estate app that sells them arrives in Chapter 2.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. You need garage space first, so pair this one with Little Boxes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
